direct.Aplica o tema escuro ao painel e aos con: Applies the dark theme to the dashboard and editor controls. Site content keeps its own colors.
direct.Aplica o tema escuro a todo o painel e a: Applies the dark theme throughout the dashboard and editor controls.
direct.Personaliza os destaques do wp-admin com: Customizes wp-admin accents with contrast for dark text.
direct.Adicione recursos ao seu workspace e ger: Add capabilities to your workspace and manage installed extensions.
direct.Personalize a experiência do painel e a: Customize your dashboard experience and accent color.
direct.Gerencie as preferências, a identidade e: Manage workspace preferences, branding and storage.
direct.Ajuste os recursos nativos para um WordP: Tune native features for a lighter WordPress.
direct.Controle os acessos e as proteções do se: Manage access and protection for your WordPress.
direct.Conecte suas ferramentas de IA ao Onun K: Connect your AI tools to Onun Kodety.
direct.Defina como você trabalha no Onun Kodety: Choose how you work in Onun Kodety.
direct.Comece com um site completo e personaliz: Start with a complete site and customize pages, styles and components in the Builder.

direct.A confirmação está incompleta. Recarregu: Confirmation is incomplete. Reload the options.
direct.Otimizações aplicadas ao site publicado: Optimizations applied to the published site
direct.O site está publicado. A sincronização d: The site is published. WordPress synchronization continues in the background.
direct.As otimizações são aplicadas à publicaçã: Optimizations apply to the published site. The editable project is preserved.
direct.Atualize o plugin WordPress para usar as: Update the WordPress plugin to use automatic optimizations.
direct.Um caminho por linha. Use * para um grup: One path per line. Use * for a group of files.
direct.Aplicar atualiza a versão publicada e pr: Apply updates the published version and preserves drafts. Publish now includes project changes.

direct.Usa a compressão disponível na hospedage: Uses compression supported by the host.
direct.WebP de alta qualidade quando fica menor: High quality WebP when it produces a smaller file.
direct.Reserva dimensões conhecidas sem adiar a: Reserves known dimensions without delaying the main image.
direct.Prioriza a fonte usada no texto principa: Prioritizes the font used for the main text.

Exclude specific pages or resources. One path per line; use * for a group of files.
direct.Salvar define as próximas publicações. A: Save sets preferences for future publications. Apply updates the published version and preserves Builder drafts.
direct.A compressão depende do suporte da hospe: Compression depends on hosting support. Resources with custom behavior remain intact; the final score also depends on the server, layout and external services.
direct.Reduz a transferência sem remover espaço: Reduces transfer size without removing whitespace, comments or code.
direct.Entrega arquivos menores quando a hosped: Delivers smaller files when hosting supports compression, preserving the original content.
direct.Cria versões WebP de alta qualidade quan: Creates high quality WebP versions when they are smaller, preserving the original file.
direct.Reserva o espaço de imagens com dimensõe: Reserves space for images with known dimensions without delaying the main image.
direct.Prioriza fontes locais usadas no texto p: Prioritizes local fonts used in the main text without loading the entire library.
direct.Antecipa recursos locais sem mudar a ord: Preloads local resources without changing script execution order or timing.
direct.Antecipa a conexão com origens já usadas: Preconnects to origins already used by essential page resources.
direct.Arquivo de código acima de 256 KB. A com: Code file above 256 KB. Compression reduces transfer size; splitting or removing code requires a project review.
direct.Esta página depende de recursos externos: This page depends on external resources. Their response times and code need to be evaluated on the published site.
Optimizations applied to the published site.
direct.O Agent não iniciou no servidor: The Agent did not start on the server
direct.A execução No servidor depende dos recur: On server execution depends on your hosting resources. If your host does not support it, select In browser in Agent settings.
direct.Esta hospedagem não oferece os recursos: This host does not provide the resources needed to run the Agent on the server. In browser runs the Agent in the Builder tab.
direct.Salve o projeto e conecte sua conta Open: Save the project and connect your OpenAI account in this environment. Keep the Builder open while the Agent works.
direct.O Agent executa neste navegador. Mantenh: The Agent runs in this browser. Keep the Builder open while it works.
direct.Design cuida da aparência, CMS organiza: Design shapes the look, CMS organizes the content, and Insights tracks results. Each area keeps its tools in one place.
direct.Você pode conhecer cada área no seu ritm: Explore each area at your own pace from the logo menu.
direct.Abra o Agent para pedir ajuda com o cont: Open Agent for help with the context of this area. Describe the result you want and follow the actions in the conversation.
direct.Type escolhe entre o fluxo normal, deslo: Type lets you choose normal flow, relative positioning, absolute positioning, Sticky, or Fixed. Side offsets appear based on the type; Z-index controls the stacking order.
direct.Absolute usa um ancestral como referênci: Absolute uses an ancestor as its reference. Fixed stays relative to the screen; Sticky follows scrolling within its container's boundaries.
direct.Layout: organize os elementos dentro da: Layout: arrange elements inside the selection
direct.Type organiza os filhos em colunas, linh: Type arranges children in columns, rows, or a grid. Align and Justify control alignment; Gap sets the space between children. Grid and wrapping options appear based on the selected type.
Visible controls whether the selection is displayed. Check the active class, state, and breakpoint before changing any Style value.
direct.Padding cria espaço entre o conteúdo e a: Padding adds space between the content and the element's edges. Margin controls the space outside. Use the diagram to adjust each side and see where the spacing applies.
direct.Para separar os filhos de um container,: To separate a container's children, use Gap in Layout. To move content away from the container's edges, use Padding.
direct.Width e Height definem largura e altura;: Width and Height set the dimensions; minimum and maximum values limit growth. Overflow controls what happens to content that extends beyond those dimensions.
direct.Em imagens e vídeos, Object fit ajusta c: For images and videos, Object fit controls how the media fills its box, and Object position selects which area stays in focus.
direct.Typography: aparência e leitura do texto: Typography: how text looks and reads
direct.Escolha a fonte, o peso, o tamanho e a c: Choose the font, weight, size, and color. Alignment arranges the lines; Letter adjusts the space between letters, and Line height controls the distance between lines of text.
direct.Estilos tipográficos definidos em um con: Text inside a container can inherit its typography styles. Select the text to adjust only its own styling.
direct.Color define o preenchimento de fundo. A: Color sets the background fill. Image options let you choose the source and adjust size, position, and repeat within the element's area.
direct.O fundo pertence à caixa selecionada. Pa: The background belongs to the selected box. To change text color, use Typography.
direct.Defina a espessura, o estilo e a cor da: Set the border's width, style, and color. Rounding controls adjust corners together or individually, helping you apply a consistent finish to cards, images, and buttons.
direct.Um canto arredondado muda o contorno. Se: A rounded corner changes the outline. If the content should follow the clipping, also check Overflow in Sizing.
direct.Opacity controla a transparência da sele: Opacity controls the selection's transparency. Shadow adjusts inner or outer shadows. The filter menu offers Blur for the element and BG Blur for what appears behind it.
direct.Reduzir Opacity afeta também o conteúdo: Reducing Opacity also affects the element's content. To make only the background transparent, adjust its color in Backgrounds.
direct.O botão + reúne Scale, Rotate, Move e Sk: The + button includes Scale, Rotate, Move, and Skew. These controls change the element's appearance and visual position; options appear when a transform is active.
direct.Move desloca a aparência sem reorganizar: Move shifts the element visually without rearranging nearby elements. To change layout spacing, check Spacing and Layout.
direct.Canvas, páginas, estilos, componentes e: Canvas, pages, styles, components, and publishing.
direct.Esta é a área visual do site. Selecione: This is your site's visual workspace. Select an element to see its properties on the right, and use the layers on the left to understand the structure.
direct.Se você vem do Elementor, pense no canva: If you come from Elementor, think of the canvas as the page editing area.
direct.Este painel reúne elementos, estruturas: This panel brings together elements, structures, and components. Search for what you need or explore the categories, then click to insert or drag onto the canvas.
direct.É o ponto de partida equivalente ao pain: This starting point is similar to Elementor's elements panel or Webflow's Add panel.
direct.Localize elementos dentro de seções e co: Find elements inside sections and containers, select small parts, and rearrange the hierarchy without relying only on the canvas.
direct.É o papel do Navigator no Webflow e da E: This serves the same role as Navigator in Webflow and Structure in Elementor.
direct.Encontre as páginas do projeto, organize: Find your project's pages, organize folders, and choose which page to edit. Page-specific options are in Settings.
direct.Gerencie imagens e outros arquivos usado: Manage images and other files used by the project. Reuse assets across pages to keep your content organized.
direct.Centralize cores, fontes e outros valore: Keep colors, fonts, and other reusable values in one place. Linking properties to a variable helps maintain a consistent style across your site.
direct.O conceito é próximo das variáveis do We: The concept is similar to variables in Webflow and global styles in Elementor.
direct.Selecione algo no canvas para editar por: Select something on the canvas to edit it here. Style controls its appearance, Settings contains its attributes, and Interactions defines its behavior.
direct.Ajuste layout, tamanho, espaçamento, tip: Adjust the selected element's layout, size, spacing, typography, colors, and borders. Check the active breakpoint and class before editing.
direct.Veja qual classe está recebendo seus aju: Check which class is receiving your changes. A reused class can affect several elements; check the editing context before changing the style.
direct.Quem vem do Webflow já conhece essa rela: If you come from Webflow, you already know this relationship between a class and the elements that use it.
direct.Configure conteúdo, links, atributos e o: Configure content, links, attributes, and options specific to the selection. Options vary by element type, such as an image, button, or form.
direct.Defina o que acontece em cliques, hover,: Define what happens on clicks, hover, entering the screen, and other events. Select an element to configure triggers, actions, and transitions.
direct.Explore efeitos prontos e confira o alvo: Explore ready-made effects and check their target and activation timing. Adjust an effect's options before applying it to the selection.
direct.A timeline organiza as ações da interaçã: The timeline organizes an interaction's actions. Use keyframes to refine values, duration, and the motion sequence.
direct.Você está editando um componente reutili: You are editing a reusable component. Variants represent its states; check which one is active and use Done to return to the page.
direct.Troque o dispositivo ou ajuste as dimens: Switch devices or adjust the viewport dimensions to review the layout. Keep an eye on the active breakpoint when working on responsive styles.
direct.Este painel abre os arquivos HTML, CSS e: This panel opens the HTML, CSS, and JavaScript files behind the same visual project. Check the selected file at the top before editing its contents.
direct.Abra Settings para cuidar da identidade: Open Settings to manage your site's identity, SEO, redirects, global code, integrations, and settings for each page.
direct.Canvas e Agent no mesmo painel: Canvas and Agent in one panel
direct.Esta é a conversa com o Agent. Diga qual: This is your conversation with Agent. Say which part of the project you want to work on and follow the requested actions. Use Canvas at the top to return to visual properties.
direct.Use Preview para conferir a navegação, l: Use Preview to check navigation, links, and interactions as a visitor. Review screen sizes before publishing, too.
direct.O botão Publicar abre as opções de publi: The Publish button opens publishing options and shows pending changes. Check the project's state before making this version available to visitors.
direct.Salvar o trabalho e publicar o site são: Saving your work and publishing your site are separate steps.
direct.Este painel mostra o estado de publicaçã: This panel shows publishing status and available actions. Review the changes and options before confirming a new version of your site.
direct.Abra o menu da logo e escolha Onboarding: Open the logo menu and choose Onboarding, just below the updates, whenever you want to revisit an area. Your choice to dismiss the guide will be respected.
direct.Coleções, campos, itens e importação de: Collections, fields, items, and content imports.
direct.Uma coleção reúne itens do mesmo tipo, c: A collection groups items of the same type, such as posts, services, or projects. Select a collection to work on its content.
direct.É o conceito de Collections no Webflow;: This is the Collections concept in Webflow; WordPress also has built-in content types.
direct.Configure os dados que uma coleção guard: Configure the data a collection stores: text, images, numbers, and other types. All items in the collection share the same field structure.
direct.Se você usa campos personalizados no Wor: If you use custom fields in WordPress, you'll recognize the same idea here.
direct.Use busca, filtros e ordenação para loca: Use search, filters, and sorting to find items. You can also choose which columns appear in the table and refresh the list.
direct.Cada linha representa um item e cada col: Each row represents an item, and each column shows a field. Open an item to edit its content and check its status before publishing it.
direct.Adicione conteúdo sem refazer o layout: Add content without rebuilding the layout
direct.Crie um item, preencha os campos da cole: Create an item, fill in the collection's fields, and set its status. On pages linked to the CMS, the data uses the visual structure you prepared.
direct.Importe uma planilha em CSV para preench: Import a CSV spreadsheet to populate the collection. Review how the file's columns map to the fields before confirming the import.
direct.Preencha os campos deste conteúdo, confi: Fill in this item's fields, check its images and status, and use the save actions. Changes apply to the open item.
direct.Identidade, SEO, integrações e ajustes d: Identity, SEO, integrations, and settings for each page.
direct.Site Settings reúne opções compartilhada: Site Settings contains options shared across the project. Page Settings organizes options specific to each page, such as title, URL, and sharing information.
direct.Em Geral, configure os dados públicos e: In General, configure the public information and images used by your site. These values help keep its identity consistent across pages.
direct.Encontre as configurações para mecanismo: Find settings for search engines, your sitemap, and site discovery. Also review the SEO for each page in the list below.
direct.Cadastre redirecionamentos quando uma UR: Add redirects when a URL changes. This helps visitors using old links reach the right destination.
direct.Ao migrar de outro builder, revise os en: When migrating from another builder, review both the old and new URLs.
direct.Configure o aviso e as categorias de con: Configure your site's notice and consent categories. Review the text and the behavior of scripts that depend on visitors' choices.
direct.Custom Code reúne trechos globais, como: Custom Code contains global snippets, such as scripts and styles. Check the insertion point and scope before saving a change.
direct.Conecte os serviços disponíveis no proje: Connect the services available to your project and configure AI and MCP integrations. The options shown depend on your account's features and permissions.
direct.Revise as configurações dos agentes disp: Review the settings for agents available to your project. These options guide the assistance used across Onun Kodety's different areas.
direct.Consulte o estado de armazenamento e os: Check storage status and available snapshots. Review the selected version before using recovery or restore actions.
direct.Conheça as opções em desenvolvimento e s: Read about features in development before enabling them. Availability may vary by project.
direct.Cada página tem seus próprios ajustes: Each page has its own settings
direct.Escolha uma página para revisar informaç: Choose a page to review its specific information, such as SEO and social image. Check the page name in the content area before editing.
direct.Leia o contexto de cada opção: Understand the context of each option
direct.O conteúdo central muda conforme a seção: The main content changes with the selected section. Labels and helper text explain the scope of the settings you are editing.
direct.A barra informa quando existem alteraçõe: The bar indicates when there are unsaved changes. Use the save action after reviewing the fields and check the result shown.
direct.Tráfego, páginas, funis, testes A/B e ca: Traffic, pages, funnels, A/B tests, and campaigns.
direct.Navegue entre tráfego, comportamento nas: Browse traffic, page behavior, funnels, and experiments. Features marked Pro depend on the access available to your project.
direct.A Visão geral reúne os principais indica: Overview brings together key traffic metrics. Check the report's date range and filters when comparing results.
direct.A Visão de página ajuda a explorar event: Page Insights helps you explore events and scroll depth on your published page. Use these signals to understand which sections get attention.
direct.Monte funis com as etapas que importam p: Build funnels with the steps that matter to your site and track progress between them. Saved funnels are available in the sidebar.
direct.Organize testes A/B para comparar versõe: Set up A/B tests to compare versions and track conversions. Check the variants, goal, and experiment status before activating it.
direct.A Central de UTMs reúne parâmetros usado: The UTM Center brings together parameters used to identify campaigns. Keep names consistent to connect traffic sources with results.
direct.Confira filtros, período e estado de car: Check the filters, date range, and loading status alongside the numbers. When Demo mode is indicated, the displayed data is simulated.
direct.Atualize o relatório por aqui. Na Visão: Refresh the report here. In Overview, you can also choose how often the dashboard refreshes automatically.
direct.O idioma fonte contém o conteúdo origina: The source language contains the original content. Select another language to review its translations and track completion progress.
direct.Adicione um idioma ao projeto: Add a language to your project
direct.Escolha o idioma e confira suas opções r: Choose a language and check its regional options before adding it. Then review the content visitors will see in this version.
direct.Revise as configurações gerais e de cada: Review general and per-language settings, including text direction and other options for the localized version.
direct.Original e tradução lado a lado: Original and translation side by side
direct.Trabalhe nos textos das páginas e nos da: Work on page text and site data using the original content as your reference. Check the active language before editing.
direct.Busque um texto e filtre os campos pende: Search for text and filter fields that are pending or already translated. This makes it easier to review content without going through every page.
direct.Abra os grupos de conteúdo e edite os ca: Open content groups and edit the translation fields. Watch the save feedback at the top to confirm your changes were saved.
direct.Quando a IA estiver configurada, gere ra: When AI is configured, generate drafts for empty fields. Review names, tone, and meaning before using the translation on your site.
direct.Pessoas, planos, acesso e configurações: People, plans, access, and members-only area settings.
direct.Esta área reúne membros, planos e config: This area brings together members, plans, and access settings. Available tools depend on whether the feature is enabled and on your account's permissions.
direct.Consulte as pessoas cadastradas e use fi: View registered members and filter by status or plan. Open a member to review their details and access options.
direct.Configure os planos usados pelas regras: Configure the plans used by the members-only area's rules. Review related members and content before changing an existing plan.
direct.Quando disponível, esta seção reúne os c: When available, this section brings together checkouts and commerce integrations for the members area. Review their links to plans before activating a setting.
direct.Revise as opções gerais da área de membr: Review general options for the members area and the flows available to your project. Read the descriptions before changing your site's behavior.
direct.Encontre um ponto de partida e reutilize: Find a starting point and reuse projects.
direct.Um ponto de partida para o site: A starting point for your site
direct.Templates reúnem páginas, estilos, compo: Templates include the pages, styles, components, and files of an editable project. Explore the options before choosing what fits your work.
direct.Use a busca e as categorias para reduzir: Use search and categories to narrow down the template list. Compare the available options before opening a project.
direct.Cada cartão informa a proposta, a origem: Each card shows the template's purpose, source, and number of pages. Use the card's action only when you're ready to open the template in the Builder.
direct.Importe um ZIP de template para disponib: Import a template ZIP to make it available in the library. Check the selected file before uploading it.
direct.Escolha o intervalo usado pelo relatório: Choose the date range used by the report. Also check the time zone in the header so that you interpret days and times consistently when comparing results.
direct.Visitantes únicos, sessões e visualizaçõ: Unique visitors, sessions, and views measure different things: identified people, visits, and pages viewed. The panel also shows live visitors, bounce rate, and average session duration.
direct.O gráfico coloca visitantes únicos e vis: The chart plots unique visitors and views on the same timeline. Look for peaks and drops before checking traffic sources.
direct.Detalhamento: de onde vem cada resultado: Breakdowns: where each result comes from
direct.Fontes, páginas, localização e dispositi: Sources, pages, locations, and devices break down the totals for the period. Tracking IDs shows the identifiers that received tracked events.
direct.A página escolhe o endereço analisado. O: Page selects the address to analyze. The device filter narrows the data, and the period defines when it was collected. Check these three controls before comparing pages.
direct.A página publicada como referência: The published page as a reference
direct.A visualização usa a página publicada pa: The preview uses the published page to locate the areas being analyzed. Fold and scroll indicators help connect the metrics to the content visitors encountered.
direct.Veja quantas sessões alcançaram cada tre: See how many sessions reached each part of the page. A drop between sections means fewer sessions reached that part; also check the device and period.
direct.Esta lista reúne cliques e envios identi: This list brings together clicks and submissions identified by tracking. The totals follow the page filters; missing events may not have occurred during this period.
direct.O nome identifica o fluxo salvo. Ativo c: The name identifies the saved flow. Active controls conversion tracking. The window limits the minutes between entry and completion; zero leaves the funnel without this overall limit.
direct.Nó selecionado: o que conta como etapa: Selected node: what counts as a step
direct.Escolha o tipo da etapa e seu alvo: pági: Choose the step type and its target: page, click, form, A/B test, email, webhook, or event. The fields below change with the type and configure only the selected node.
direct.A ação escolhe entre atualizar o contato: The action chooses whether to update the contact or add them to a list. Field names identify the email and name fields in the form. When there is a consent field, it must be checked to subscribe the contact.
direct.Webhook: a ação enviada ao destino: Webhook: the action sent to the destination
direct.URL, método e formato definem como o ser: The URL, method, and format define how the external service receives the request. The event name identifies the action, and the configured secret lets the destination verify its signature.
direct.Esses campos configuram uma ação do funi: These fields configure a funnel action. The guide only explains the controls and does not send any requests.
direct.A conexão liga dois nós. A espera mínima: The connection links two nodes. The minimum delay postpones progress; the maximum deadline limits completion. A deadline of zero inherits the overall window. Filters restrict which visitors can follow this route.
direct.Cada filtro combina campo, operador e va: Each filter combines a field, operator, and value to define entry into the funnel. Without entry filters, all visitors can start the flow; connection conditions are still evaluated separately.
direct.Entraram corresponde à primeira etapa e: Entered corresponds to the first step, and Converted to the last. The overall conversion rate relates these two totals; highest drop-off highlights the transition with the greatest loss during the selected period.
direct.Objetivo: qual ação representa conversão: Goal: which action counts as a conversion
direct.Selecione o ID ou a classe do elemento a: Select the ID or class of the element activated for a conversion. The current target appears above the controls so you can confirm what will be measured across all variants.
direct.Participação escolhe a parcela dos visit: Participation selects the share of visitors who enter the test. Distribution splits that share among variants. Delivery chooses whether to redirect or keep the original URL; persistence defines how many days a visitor stays in the variant.
direct.Audiência: quem é elegível para o teste: Audience: who is eligible for the test
direct.Dispositivo, visitante, domínio de refer: Device, visitor, referring domain, and campaign parameter restrict who participates. The expected value completes the rule for the selected parameter.
direct.Defina uma data e hora, um limite de exp: Set a date and time, an exposure limit, or both. The test ends when it reaches the first configured rule. Without these rules, ending the test remains manual.
direct.Confira nome, endereço público, particip: Check each variant's name, public address, participation, and status. Control is the baseline and stays active. Changes that require publishing are marked in the list itself.
direct.A URL base é o endereço que receberá os: The base URL is the address that will receive the parameters. For checkouts, the platform determines the available preset. Existing parameters and the link fragment are preserved.
direct.Source identifica a origem, Medium descr: Source identifies the origin, Medium describes the channel, and Campaign names the campaign. Content distinguishes creatives or placements; Term identifies the term associated with the link.
direct.Repassar UTMs leva ao checkout os parâme: Forward UTMs passes received parameters supported by the platform to checkout. Remember for this session keeps attribution across pages in the same session, when available.
direct.Cada linha liga um dado de origem a um p: Each row links a source value to a parameter accepted by the platform. Check the name expected by the destination and the source of the value before applying the template to a form or link.
direct.Cole um endereço HTTP ou HTTPS para sepa: Paste an HTTP or HTTPS address to separate the destination, UTMs, and other parameters. This helps you understand a campaign link before reusing its values.
direct.O código identifica idioma e, quando nec: The code identifies the language and, when needed, the region, such as pt-BR or en-US. It distinguishes regional versions even when they use the same language.
direct.Prefixo: o endereço dessa versão: Prefix: the address of this version
direct.O prefixo diferencia o caminho publicado: The prefix distinguishes the published path for the language. The default language uses the URL without a prefix; the field indicates when this value is fixed for the current configuration.
direct.Fallback: de onde vem o conteúdo ausente: Fallback: where missing content comes from
direct.Escolha o idioma que fornece o conteúdo: Choose the language that supplies content when a translation is empty. Review this relationship so that pending fields have a consistent reference.
direct.Escolha esquerda para direita ou direita: Choose left to right or right to left according to the language's writing system. This option sets the text direction for the localized version.
direct.Este controle define se a versão entra n: This control determines whether the version is included in the next publication. Check its translations, paths, and fallback before making it available to visitors.
direct.A coluna Original mostra o texto fonte e: The Original column shows the source text, and the language column receives the translation. These fields contain global information, such as the site name and description.
direct.Os campos de SEO traduzem o título e a d: The SEO fields translate the current page's title and description. They are separate from the visible text within the page and need to be reviewed for each language.
direct.Este campo define o caminho da página no: This field defines the page path in the active language when localized URLs are enabled. Check the translated path together with the language prefix.
direct.Edite a tradução ao lado do texto origin: Edit the translation beside the original text. Pending fields are marked in the row; the save feedback at the top indicates whether your changes were saved.
direct.Fonte identifica o conteúdo original. Pa: Source identifies the original content. Default chooses which language uses the URL without a prefix. They serve different purposes and may not refer to the same version.
direct.Idioma automático considera o país do vi: Automatic language considers the visitor's country; Remember choice keeps their preference. Localized URLs allows translated paths, and Include URLs in drafts enables AI path suggestions.
direct.Busque por nome ou email e combine os fi: Search by name or email and combine the status and plan filters. Active, invited, and suspended represent different account states; the plan filter narrows the memberships shown.
direct.Os planos selecionados determinam os vín: The selected plans determine the access memberships recognized by WordPress. Assignment depends on the permissions of the account editing the member.
direct.Escolha o plano e, se necessário, regist: Choose the plan and, if needed, record a reason. Adding or removing access changes authorization on the site. Restore sync returns control to the provider connection.
direct.Alterar o acesso aqui não cancela a assi: Changing access here does not cancel a subscription or refund a sale.
direct.As ações geram um link temporário de ace: These actions generate a temporary access link, generate a password reset link, or send a recovery email. They only run when you activate them; check the member identified above.
direct.Cada plano possui uma chave usada pelas: Each plan has a key used by Builder rules. Open a plan to review its identity, status, and upgrade destination; the guide leaves the list as it is.
direct.O cartão reúne nome, estado, chave estáv: The card brings together the name, status, stable key, and description. Identify the plan before using its edit or archive actions.
direct.O nome identifica o plano para as pessoa: The name identifies the plan for people. The key connects the access rules and remains fixed after creation to preserve existing relationships.
direct.Ativo, rascunho e arquivado indicam a si: Active, draft, and archived indicate the plan's status. Check how members and access rules use it before changing its status.
direct.A URL de upgrade aponta para a página ou: The upgrade URL points to the page or offer used when someone needs to obtain this plan. Check that the destination matches the configured access level.
direct.Provedor e ID externo registram a referê: Provider and external ID record the reference associated with the plan. The actual link to a product, price, and checkout is configured in the commerce area.
direct.As conexões identificam os serviços que: Connections identify the services that process purchases. Check each connection's name, environment, and status before linking plans to its products.
direct.O mapeamento liga um plano Onun Kodety a: The mapping links a Onun Kodety plan to a provider's product or price. This relationship determines which access will be granted; the permanent link creates a checkout session each time it is used.
direct.Nome e ambiente identificam a conexão. O: The name and environment identify the connection. The requested fields vary by provider; credentials are sent to WordPress, and secret fields stay empty when you reopen the form.
direct.Escolha qual provedor processa a compra: Choose which provider processes the purchase and which plan grants access. Once created, this mapping keeps its connection and plan fixed to preserve its identity.
direct.Use os filtros para consultar as vendas: Use the filters to review recorded sales and connect the purchase, member, and payment status. Refresh retrieves the latest available status.
direct.Os filtros de provedor e estado organiza: The provider and status filters organize subscriptions. Review the subscription record before connecting its billing status to the member's access.
direct.Cadastro público permite criar contas pe: Public registration allows accounts to be created through member area forms. The default role chooses between subscriber and customer for new accounts. Email verification remains marked as unavailable while it is being prepared.
direct.Configure login, conta, upgrade e redefi: Configure login, account, upgrade, and password reset pages. After login and After logout choose where visitors go when they complete these actions.
direct.Os valores em dias controlam por quanto: Values in days control how long audit records and events are kept. Both accept between 30 and 3,650 days; review them and use Save settings to save your changes.
direct.Esta área ainda está carregando ou não e: This area is still loading or is not available on this screen. You can choose another area or try again.
direct.A navegação foi interrompida. Resolva as: Navigation was interrupted. Resolve the pending changes in the current area and try again.
direct.Não foi possível abrir esta área. Tente: Could not open this area. Try again.
direct.Abra o painel desta etapa para acompanha: Open this step’s panel to follow the explanation, or move on whenever you like.
Progress is available for this session.

direct.Seu navegador não permitiu guardar o pro: Your browser did not allow progress to be saved. You can revisit the guide from the logo menu.
direct.Escolha uma área e acompanhe as explicaç: Choose an area and follow the explanations right in the interface.
direct.Vem do Elementor ou Webflow? Encontre os: Coming from Elementor or Webflow? Find the concepts you already know.

direct.Escolha a propriedade e a duração da tra: Choose the property and transition duration. When that property changes, such as on hover, the browser interpolates its values over the specified time.
direct.Scroll Section: um destino dentro da pág: Scroll Section: a destination within the page
direct.Defina um nome para tornar esta seleção: Set a name to make this selection a navigation destination. The vertical offset adjusts where scrolling stops, which is useful with a fixed header.
direct.Configure as cores usadas quando um visi: Configure the colors used when a visitor selects text. On Body, these settings can apply to text across the entire page.
direct.Esses controles configuram a aparência d: These controls configure the scrollbar's appearance within the selected scope. Check the thumb's contrast and visibility while navigating.
direct.Adicione propriedades CSS que precisem d: Add CSS properties that need direct adjustments. Check the active selector, state, and breakpoint: they determine where the declaration applies.
direct.Code Overrides: arquivos ligados à seleç: Code Overrides: files linked to the selection
direct.Associe arquivos CSS ou JavaScript para: Link CSS or JavaScript files to extend the selection. Each link identifies the source of the behavior; removing a link and editing the file are separate actions.
direct.Fluid Responsive: medidas entre tamanhos: Fluid Responsive: sizing between screen widths
direct.Defina os viewports de referência e míni: Set the reference and minimum viewports, root font size, and scaling limit. The preview shows the conversion; Generate clamp() and Convert to rem apply the operation to the page and its descendants.
direct.Hairlines preserva traços finos e Ignore: Hairlines preserves thin strokes, and Ignore excludes properties from conversion. Review these limits before applying.
direct.A busca filtra o catálogo. Use o nome do: Search filters the catalog. Use the element's name or browse the categories to find structures, text, media, and forms.
direct.Elements: as peças da página: Elements: the building blocks of a page
direct.Cada categoria reúne elementos com uma f: Each category groups elements by function. Start with the structure that organizes your content, then choose text, images, links, and form fields.
direct.Esta categoria reúne componentes do próp: This category contains components from the project itself. An instance reuses its structure and can offer properties and variants to adapt the content.
direct.Os elementos de CMS conectam a página a: CMS elements connect the page to structured data. After inserting one, configure the collection, fields, and filters in the selection's properties.
direct.Confira a peça antes de inserir: Check the element before inserting it
direct.Os cartões mostram os elementos da categ: The cards show elements from the current category or search. Click to insert an element, or drag it to choose its position on the canvas.
direct.O guia só apresenta o catálogo. A inserç: The guide only introduces the catalog. An element is inserted when you choose one.
direct.Este seletor mostra a página que fornece: This selector shows the page that supplies the layers. Use it to switch pages without leaving Layers; the canvas and tree then follow the chosen page.
direct.Encontre uma camada pelo que ela contém: Find a layer by its contents
direct.Busque pelo nome, tag, ID, classe ou tex: Search by the element's name, tag, ID, class, or text. The ancestors of matching results remain in the tree to show where each match is located.
direct.Leia a estrutura de fora para dentro: Read the structure from the outside in
direct.O recuo mostra quais elementos pertencem: Indentation shows which elements belong to each container. Expand branches to reach their children; when dragging a layer, check the destination indicator before dropping it.
direct.A seleção conecta a árvore ao canvas: Selection connects the tree to the canvas
direct.Clique em uma camada para ver suas propr: Click a layer to see its properties in the inspector. The actions menu includes options such as duplicate, lock, and hide; Hidden on Builder hides the element only in the editor and keeps it on the site.
direct.A busca considera o nome e o caminho da: Search checks the page name and path, along with the names of related tests and variants. Clear the field to return to the full structure.
direct.Cada página tem seu próprio contexto: Each page has its own context
direct.Selecione uma página para abrir seu cont: Select a page to open its content on the canvas. The row menu contains available actions, including settings, code, and organization; the house icon identifies the home page.
direct.Expanda a pasta para encontrar o conteúd: Expand a folder to find its contents. Dragging pages or folders reorganizes their paths; check the indicated destination and review links after moving them.
direct.O botão + cria uma página vazia em rascu: The + button creates an empty draft page and opens it on the canvas. Then adjust its name and path through the page options, prepare the layout, and review SEO and publishing.
direct.Uma busca para mídia e arquivos: One search for media and files
direct.Digite parte do nome ou caminho para loc: Enter part of a name or path to find project files. Search filters both the media library and the file tree.
direct.Traga os arquivos que o site precisa: Bring in the files your site needs
direct.Adicionar mídia permite selecionar vário: Add media lets you select multiple files from your computer. The adjacent Create file button creates a text file at the specified path, such as styles/adjustments.css.
direct.Esta seção reúne as prévias dos arquivos: This section contains previews of visual files. Each item's menu offers supported actions, such as replace, compress, or convert; review pages that use the media before changing it.
direct.A árvore mostra onde cada arquivo vive: The tree shows where each file lives
direct.Explore as pastas e abra um arquivo para: Browse folders and open a file to edit it in the code panel. The type filter helps separate styles, scripts, and other files; check the path before renaming or removing a file.
direct.Abra a compressão para revisar qualidade: Open compression to review quality and dimensions before applying. Compression and conversion require compatible images and an active license; their controls appear in the Media section.
direct.O breakpoint indica o contexto de Style: The breakpoint sets the Style context
direct.Escolha um dos tamanhos principais para: Choose one of the main sizes to review the layout. Before adjusting a property, check the active breakpoint and the selection's class to understand where the style will apply.
direct.Arraste esta borda para variar a largura: Drag this edge to vary the viewport width and find layout issues between the main sizes. Watch text wrapping, menus, and columns as you adjust.
direct.Enquadre a tela sem redimensionar os ele: Fit the view without resizing elements
direct.Ajustar canvas muda o enquadramento para: Fit canvas adjusts the view to fit the workspace. Use it after switching breakpoints; the viewing scale is separate from the dimensions set in Style.
direct.Mantenha cada conversa no contexto certo: Keep each conversation in the right context
direct.O seletor mostra a sessão atual e permit: The selector shows the current session and lets you return to existing conversations. New session starts another conversation; check the title before continuing an earlier request.
direct.Diga qual parte do projeto deve mudar e: Say which part of the project should change and which details need to be preserved. A concrete reference, such as “reduce the space above the heading on mobile,” helps guide the request.
direct.O botão + reúne imagens, arquivos e skil: The + button brings together images, files, and skills. Review the attachments and selected skills before sending; they supplement the text you wrote.
direct.Escolha modelo e esforço para a tarefa: Choose a model and effort for the task
direct.Este menu reúne os modelos disponíveis,: This menu lists the available models, reasoning effort, and remaining usage reported by the account. Check these options before starting a longer request.
direct.Enviar inicia o trabalho descrito na men: Send starts the work described in the message. While it runs, the control lets you stop the Agent; follow the conversation's updates and check the result on the canvas and in Preview.
direct.Preview abre a página em uma aba de revi: Preview opens the page in a review tab, where you can test links, menus, and interactions. The Builder tab remains available for editing; use the review controls to switch devices or reload.
direct.Escolha um dispositivo ou ajuste largura: Choose a device or adjust width and height when those fields are available. Fit preview fits the view to the workspace.
direct.Recarregar reinicia a prévia. Use depois: Reload restarts the preview. Use it after navigating or interacting to test the behavior again from the initial page load.
direct.Confira a prévia em outra aba: Check the preview in another tab
direct.Quando um endereço de preview está dispo: When a preview URL is available, this control opens it in a new tab. The adjacent copy button lets you copy that address for review.
direct.Volte ao layout depois de testar: Return to the layout after testing
direct.Na aba de revisão, Voltar à edição fecha: In the review tab, Back to editing closes the preview. Continue in the Builder tab, address what you found, and open Preview again to check the result before publishing.
direct.Separe os valores reutilizáveis por fina: Group reusable values by purpose, such as brand colors, typography, or spacing. Selecting a collection changes the list shown on the right.
direct.Busque valores e escolha o tipo: Find values and choose a type
direct.A busca encontra variáveis da coleção po: Search finds variables in the collection by name, value, or type. New variable offers the available types, such as color, size, number, font, and duration.
direct.Uma variável pode alcançar várias partes: One variable can reach many places
direct.A lista mostra nomes e valores da coleçã: The list shows the collection's names and values. Editing a token updates the controls linked to it. Deleting it preserves the values already applied in the project.
direct.Nome, tipo e valor têm papéis diferentes: Name, type, and value have different roles
direct.O nome ajuda a reconhecer a intenção do: The name helps identify the token's purpose. The type determines which controls can use it; the value is what gets applied. The collection organizes the token. Save when the setup is ready.
direct.Use nomes por função, como “Texto princi: Use names based on purpose, such as “Primary text” or “Space between sections,” to make reuse easier.
direct.Neste campo você cria ou encontra classe: Create or find classes for the selection in this field. A class can apply to several elements; its Style adjustments are shared according to the active context.
direct.Confira qual classe está recebendo os aj: Check which class you are adjusting
direct.O indicador Editing mostra a classe ativ: The Editing indicator shows the active class. The combination of classes defines the rule's context; selecting another chip changes where subsequent adjustments apply.
direct.Estado visual: Normal, hover e outros: Visual state: Normal, hover, and more
direct.Escolha o estado antes de configurar a a: Choose the state before configuring the appearance. A hover rule, for example, changes the style when the pointer is over the element. The breakpoint remains part of this context.
direct.Identidade e atributos da seleção: Identity and attributes of the selection
direct.ID identifica um elemento na página e po: ID identifies an element on the page and can serve as a link destination. Tag defines its HTML semantics. Tracking ID helps identify it in analytics; Title provides an additional description.
direct.Edite o texto da seleção. Quando uma pro: Edit the selection's text. When a property is connected to the CMS or a component variable, check the indicated source before changing the value.
direct.Escolha página, seção, URL, e-mail, tele: Choose a page, section, URL, email, phone number, or file as the destination. New tab, download, and relationship options complete the link's behavior.
direct.Defina o arquivo ou URL e as opções próp: Set the file or URL and the options specific to the selected media. Images use alternative text to describe their contents; video and audio can offer playback controls.
direct.Configure o destino dos dados, a ação ap: Configure the data destination, the action after submission, and success or error messages. Field names identify submitted values; validation and spam protection complete the flow.
direct.Name identifica o dado enviado. O tipo e: Name identifies the submitted data. The type and validation rules define the accepted format; placeholder guides the input. Required means the user must provide this value.
direct.Adicione atributos ao HTML quando uma in: Add HTML attributes when an integration or behavior requires them. Check the name and value expected by the integration before applying.
direct.Clique, entrada na tela, movimento do cu: Clicking, entering the viewport, pointer movement, and scrolling start different behaviors. Choose the event for the experience you want; actions define what happens next.
direct.Reaproveite sequências já guardadas na b: Reuse sequences already saved in the library. When applying one, check the selection and targets so the motion affects the intended elements.
direct.A lista reúne os gatilhos associados ao: The list contains triggers associated with the element. Open an interaction to review its details. The activation control lets you turn its behavior on or off.
direct.O evento define quando começar. O alvo d: The event defines when to start. The target determines which element receives that event: the selection, a specific selector, or another available target.
direct.Configure como a sequência responde a no: Configure how the sequence responds to new activations and whether it should repeat or return. Check the result in Preview after defining the actions.
direct.Esses controles definem quando a rolagem: These controls define when scrolling activates the interaction. The progress tracking option ties animation progress to the scroll position.
direct.Configure como a posição do ponteiro inf: Configure how the pointer's position influences the interaction and whether the element should return when the pointer leaves.
direct.Escolha em quais breakpoints a interação: Choose which breakpoints support the interaction and how it respects the reduced motion preference. Review the devices on which the trigger makes sense.
direct.Ações: o resultado do gatilho: Actions: the result of the trigger
direct.Organize as ações que a interação execut: Organize the actions the interaction performs. Each can have its own target and parameters; their order and timing determine the resulting sequence.
direct.Use esta configuração quando o gatilho v: Use this setting when the trigger comes from code. Check the expected event and the element that dispatches it to connect the behavior to the sequence.
direct.As faixas organizam as ações ao longo do: Tracks organize actions over time. The position of each segment indicates when it starts; its edges adjust the duration.
direct.Aproxime para ajustar momentos pequenos: Zoom in to adjust small moments or zoom out to see the full sequence. Zoom changes the view, not the animation's duration.
direct.O alvo da animação pode ser diferente do: The animation target can differ from the element that received the trigger. Check the selector or choose the target on the canvas before configuring the values.
direct.Defina duração, atraso e curva de movime: Set the duration, delay, and easing curve. Delay changes when the action starts; the curve controls how the change accelerates and decelerates.
direct.Cada propriedade descreve uma mudança vi: Each property describes a visual change. The source and destination values determine its path; keyframes allow adjustments at other points in the action.
direct.As opções de sequência organizam repetiç: Sequence options organize how actions repeat and run. Review the full sequence to see which changes happen together or one after another.
direct.O arquivo ativo define o que você edita: The active file determines what you edit
direct.Use este seletor para abrir HTML, CSS, J: Use this selector to open HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and other text files. Check the path before changing the contents: each file has a role in the project.
direct.Código e canvas compartilham o projeto: Code and canvas share the project
direct.As alterações neste editor fazem parte d: Changes in this editor affect the files used by the site. Review the visual result after editing structure, styles, or scripts.
direct.Formatar organiza a escrita do arquivo c: Format organizes the code in supported files. Maximize expands the editor; Close collapses the panel. Use the project actions to save or publish the version you want.
direct.Os avisos identificam problemas encontra: Warnings identify problems found in the code. When a line is associated with a diagnostic, click it to locate the section that needs review.
direct.Selecione a variante antes de editar sua: Select the variant before editing its appearance. Changes belong to the active state; the order and initial variant help organize the component's behavior.
direct.Variables expõe valores que cada instânc: Variables exposes values that each instance can customize. Events defines how the component responds to actions and moves between variants.
direct.Uma propriedade exposta permite ajustar: An exposed property lets you adjust content or appearance without detaching the component. The reset control restores the default value defined in the component.
direct.Busque um efeito por nome e confira a pr: Search for an effect by name and check its preview. The preset provides a starting point for adjusting the selection's behavior.
direct.Os filtros separam efeitos pelo momento: Filters group effects by activation timing, such as entering the viewport, interaction, or continuous motion. Choose the timing that suits the element.
direct.Confira o alvo, o tipo de ativação e as: Check the target, activation type, and preset options. Applying changes the project's interaction; adjust the parameters for the current selection.
direct.Confira o endereço que receberá a versão: Check the address that will receive the published version. The panel's status indicates whether there are pending project changes.
direct.Estas opções controlam o processamento d: These options control file processing during publishing. Review each feature and use preserved paths to exclude files that need to remain intact.
direct.Salvar preferências guarda a configuraçã: Save preferences stores the configuration. Apply to published site updates the existing version; Publish now includes the project's changes.
direct.Revise a versão e confirme quando quiser: Review the version and confirm when ready
direct.O rodapé identifica a release atual e re: The footer identifies the current release and contains the final actions. Publish sends the changes to the site; cancel or close to continue editing.
direct.Rascunho guarda conteúdo em preparação;: Draft keeps content in preparation; Pending marks content for review. Published and Private appear according to your permissions. The status selected in the panel only takes effect when you save the item.
direct.Dê ao conteúdo um nome claro. Ele identi: Give the content a clear name. It identifies the item in the list and can populate card and page titles when Design is connected to this field.
direct.Escreva o conteúdo principal com a forma: Write the main content using the formatting available in this field. Design connections use this value; the visual structure of cards and pages stays in the Builder.
direct.Confira o caminho do item e a prévia de: Check the item's path and URL preview. Changing the slug changes the address used by links to this content; review related connections and redirects.
direct.Esta imagem representa o item em temas e: This image represents the item in WordPress themes and previews. You can choose or replace the media and check the thumbnail before saving.
direct.A busca da lateral filtra os tipos de co: The sidebar search filters content types by name. Use it to find the collection before looking for an item within it.
direct.Cada coleção reúne itens com a mesma est: Each collection groups items with the same structure. The sidebar selection determines which items, fields, and counts appear in the main area.
direct.Coleções são equivalentes às Collections: Collections are equivalent to Webflow Collections. Native types and custom collections can appear together.
direct.Gerenciar campos abre a estrutura da col: Manage fields opens the current collection's structure. Custom fields become available in table columns, the item editor, and Design connections.
direct.Confira a coleção antes de editar campos: Check the collection before editing fields
direct.O seletor indica qual tipo de conteúdo r: The selector indicates which content type will receive the structure. A field change applies to the items in that collection.
direct.A lista separa os campos fornecidos pelo: The list separates fields provided by WordPress from custom fields. Select an existing custom field to check its definition.
direct.Nome visível: a linguagem de quem preenc: Display name: a label for content editors
direct.Este é o rótulo mostrado no editor. Pref: This is the label shown in the editor. Use clear names, such as Project cover or Summary, to guide content entry.
direct.O identificador é a chave usada para lig: The identifier is the key used to connect this data to visual elements. Use a stable, recognizable name; review existing links before renaming it.
The description appears when filling in items. Explain the expected format, purpose, and any editorial guidance that helps avoid confusion.
direct.Texto, imagem, número, data e outros tip: Text, image, number, date, and other types offer their own controls. Choose the format of the content that will be stored and connected to Design.
direct.Trocar o tipo de um campo existente exig: Changing an existing field's type requires checking the values already entered.
direct.Obrigatório: o que não pode faltar: Required: what cannot be left out
direct.Quando esta opção está ativa, o item pre: When this option is enabled, the item must have a value in this field to be saved. Use it for data essential to publishing.
direct.Valor padrão: ponto de partida de novos: Default value: a starting point for new items
direct.O valor padrão preenche o campo na criaç: The default value fills the field when an item is created and remains editable. It provides an initial value for editorial work.
direct.Mínimo e Máximo restringem a faixa aceit: Minimum and Maximum restrict the accepted range. Step defines the control's increment, and Unit indicates how the value is presented during entry.
direct.Abra a busca para localizar um item pelo: Open search to find an item by its content. The collection selected in the sidebar determines the set being searched.
direct.O filtro permite revisar publicados, ras: The filter lets you review published, draft, and pending items. It changes the displayed list without changing item statuses.
direct.Este controle alterna entre ordem cresce: This control switches between ascending and descending order for the current sort field. Table sorting helps review data and does not rearrange the site's layout.
direct.Colunas visíveis define quais campos apa: Visible columns determines which fields appear in the table. Choose a combination of fields that makes review easier; scroll horizontally to see columns that do not fit on screen.
direct.Os cabeçalhos identificam o dado de cada: Headers identify the data in each column and provide sorting options. Check the field before editing a cell.
direct.Cada linha representa um item. Abra o it: Each row represents an item. Open the item to work in the panel; inline cell editing controls send your changes to the CMS.
direct.Ao revisar conteúdo com o guia aberto, o: When reviewing content with the guide open, the actual controls remain available.
direct.Escolha um CSV com a primeira linha cont: Choose a CSV whose first row contains the column names. The importer detects commas, semicolons, and tabs as separators.
direct.Destino: onde os itens serão criados: Destination: where items will be created
direct.Confira se os dados vão para uma coleção: Check whether the data goes to an existing collection or a new one. Name, singular name, and slug identify a new collection when that option is selected.
direct.Mapeamento: ligue cada coluna ao campo c: Mapping: connect each column to the right field
direct.Relacione os cabeçalhos do CSV aos campo: Match CSV headers to destination fields. Check new fields and their types before confirming, especially images, numbers, and dates.
direct.Prévia: valide uma amostra do arquivo: Preview: validate a sample of the file
direct.A tabela mostra as primeiras linhas ante: The table shows the first rows before type conversion. Check separators, accented characters, and how values are distributed across columns.
direct.Escolha se os itens entram como rascunho: Choose whether items are imported as drafts or published. Review the destination, mapping, and status before running the import.
direct.Nome, idioma e descrição representam o p: Name, language, and description represent the project. The general description serves as a fallback for pages without their own description.
direct.URL pública: a referência do site public: Public URL: the published site's reference address
direct.Informe o endereço público usado como ba: Enter the public address used as the base for canonical URLs. Check the protocol and domain so metadata points to the correct address.
direct.Favicons para temas claro e escuro: Favicons for light and dark themes
direct.Essas imagens identificam o site nas aba: These images identify the site in browser tabs. The light version is also used as a fallback when there is no image specifically for the dark theme.
direct.A imagem padrão atende páginas sem image: The default image is used for pages without their own image. A library template can generate reusable images; editing that template affects the pages linked to it.
direct.O modelo combina as informações da págin: The template combines page information with the site's identity. Check the variables shown in the field to keep titles clear and consistent.
direct.A prévia reúne título, endereço e descri: The preview brings together the title, address, and description calculated from the current defaults. Use it to identify missing or unclear information.
direct.Os controles definem padrões para novas: These controls set defaults for new pages, links, images, and snippets. The sitemap lists addresses for discovery; robots options guide crawling and how content is presented.
direct.As diretivas complementam as regras gera: These directives supplement the rules generated by the project. Review the affected paths and crawlers before saving so you do not block areas that should be discovered.
direct.Tipo, nome, URL, logo e perfis oficiais: Type, name, URL, logo, and official profiles describe the organization. The WebSite and internal search options connect that identity to the site's structure.
direct.Use este campo para entidades adicionais: Use this field for additional site entities. They join the same structured data graph; check validation messages before saving.
direct.Verifique o site nos serviços de busca: Verify the site with search services
direct.Insira os códigos de verificação forneci: Enter the verification codes provided by Google Search Console, Bing, or Pinterest. The corresponding tags are applied to the project's pages.
direct.Cada entrada tem um nome, escopo e conte: Each entry has its own name, scope, and content. The list order also determines the order in which snippets are inserted into the document.
direct.Inserir em: o ponto do documento: Insert at: the position in the document
direct.Escolha início ou fim do head ou do body: Choose the start or end of the head or body as required by the integration. The position controls where the snippet appears in the published HTML.
direct.Páginas: o alcance do trecho: Pages: the scope of the snippet
direct.Uma entrada pode valer para todas as pág: An entry can apply to all pages or only selected ones. Check this scope to avoid loading the same integration where it is not needed.
direct.Executar: uma vez ou em cada navegação: Run: once or on every navigation
direct.Uma vez atende inicializações, listeners: Once suits initialization, listeners, and external scripts. On every navigation suits code that needs to run again when the visitor switches pages.
direct.HTML, CSS e JavaScript determinam a ling: HTML, CSS, and JavaScript determine the snippet's language. Check the contents when switching languages, especially if you are still using the starter code.
direct.Escolha se a entrada exige autorização e: Choose whether the entry requires consent and assign the corresponding category. Cookie Consent must be configured and active for visitors to allow protected code to run.
direct.Revise o trecho completo, incluindo as t: Review the complete snippet, including any required tags. Entries are inserted into the published document according to their position, pages, and execution rules.
direct.Origem: o endereço que precisa continuar: Source: the address that needs to keep working
direct.Use o caminho antigo começando por /. A: Use the old path, starting with /. The source identifies which request should be forwarded to another address.
direct.O destino aceita um caminho interno ou u: The destination accepts an internal path or a secure external URL. Check that the destination page exists and that the rule does not lead back to its own source.
direct.301 e 308 indicam mudança permanente; 30: 301 and 308 indicate a permanent change; 302 and 307 indicate a temporary change. The 307 and 308 options preserve the request method.
direct.Correspondência: o alcance da regra: Match: the scope of the rule
direct.Caminho exato afeta uma URL. Caminho e s: Exact path affects one URL. Path and subpaths expands the scope; Wildcard uses the pattern specified in the source. Check priority, conflicts, and loops before saving.
direct.Configure como o aviso aparece e quando: Configure how the notice appears and when nonessential services can run. The options in this section control the overall behavior of the published feature.
direct.Aparência: integre o aviso ao site: Appearance: match the notice to your site
direct.Ajuste cores, posicionamento e apresenta: Adjust the banner's colors, position, and presentation. The preview follows your changes so you can check the visual result before saving.
direct.Textos: explique as escolhas ao visitant: Text: explain the choices to visitors
direct.Edite o conteúdo do aviso e os rótulos d: Edit the notice's content and action labels. Use text that matches the categories and services the site actually uses.
direct.Cada categoria representa uma finalidade: Each category represents a purpose of use. Necessary remains required; optional categories organize the choices visitors make.
direct.O serviço relaciona fornecedor, finalida: A service links a provider, purpose, retention, and integrations to a category. Check the category and the information presented to visitors.
direct.Registre nome, fornecedor, finalidade e: Record the name, provider, purpose, and duration of the cookies in use. This inventory is available in the published preferences.
direct.Relacione as integrações às categorias a: Assign integrations to the appropriate categories and configure the available Consent Mode options. Unmapped scripts need explicit review.
direct.Revise regras regionais e demais control: Review regional rules and other behavior controls. Presets are operational starting points and need to reflect the site's practices.
direct.Preencha os identificadores das integraç: Enter the identifiers for the integrations in use. Review loading, consent, and Do Not Track to determine when external measurement takes place.
direct.MCP: acesso de agentes ao projeto: MCP: agent access to the project
direct.Esta área reúne dados de conexão e acess: This area contains connection details and access associated with the project. Review existing connections and the project context before authorizing new clients.
direct.O provedor define o serviço usado nas so: The provider determines the service used for content requests. Model, language, tone, and creativity guide the generation available in the project.
direct.Escolha um modelo disponível para o prov: Choose an available model from the selected provider. This model is used for content requests under this configuration.
direct.O campo recebe a chave que autentica as: This field accepts the key that authenticates requests to the AI service. Check the active provider and credential status before saving the integration.
direct.Adobe Fonts: disponibilize o projeto de: Adobe Fonts: make the font project available
direct.Configure a integração com o projeto de: Configure the integration with the Adobe font project used by the site. Check the project identifier before choosing those fonts in Design.
direct.A integração reúne a loja, os dados de S: The integration brings together the store, Storefront data, markets, routes, and templates used by WordPress.
direct.Use o domínio myshopify.com corresponden: Use the store's corresponding myshopify.com domain. It identifies the source of the catalog queried by the integration.
direct.Confira o tipo de token e sua credencial: Check the token type and your Storefront credential. This configuration allows queries to the store data made available to the integration.
direct.As opções de país e idioma definem o con: Country and language options define the market context for queries. Check the store's options to present the right catalog for the site's audience.
direct.Defina os caminhos usados por produtos e: Define the paths used by products and collections within the site. Check existing addresses before changing this mapping.
direct.Templates: o visual de produtos e coleçõ: Templates: how products and collections look
direct.Associe os templates dinâmicos que apres: Assign the dynamic templates that display Shopify data. The catalog supplies the content; templates control its presentation in the Builder.
direct.Confira os hosts que podem receber o vis: Check the hosts that can receive visitors during checkout. Keep this list aligned with the configured provider and integration.
direct.Configure os destinos de retorno e cance: Configure return and cancellation destinations in WordPress. They determine where visitors return based on the outcome of the flow.
direct.A lista identifica os snapshots disponív: The list identifies available snapshots by version and date, including the current publication. View and download actions help you check a version before any maintenance.
direct.Estes valores pertencem à página indicad: These values belong to the page indicated in the header. Changing the URL also renames the published file; check the address before saving.
direct.Escolha indexação, acompanhamento de lin: Choose indexing, link following, and sitemap inclusion for the current page. Advanced options adjust images, snippets, and previews.
direct.Escolha o tipo principal e revise os dad: Choose the main type and review the corresponding structured data. The information should represent the page's actual content.
direct.Personalize como esta página se apresent: Customize how this page appears when shared. Check its own values and the fallbacks that will be used when a field is empty.
direct.Associe uma imagem ou template apropriad: Assign an image or template that suits the content. A reused template keeps multiple pages linked to the same image layout.
